_comment: Single reviewable source of truth for which verify-release-live.yml surfaces gate the aggregate (#956, milestone #769). Every surface must be listed. A surface with required=false MUST carry a reason: it is NOT skipped silently and NOT reported green — the Summary job prints 'NOT REQUIRED (out of milestone scope)' plus this reason on every run, so descoping is a visible decision made in a PR. Changing this file is a change to the release gate: it is under .github/workflows/ and therefore code-owned.
milestone: Internal beta — Android + desktop (#769); iOS and the desktop auto-update channel deferred

desktop-installer.description: Latest GitHub Release carries a signed installer per required platform, each matching CHECKSUMS.txt

staging-backend.description: Staging backend health, setup state and ntfy push relay

play-track.description: Play internal track versionCode matches the latest release

testflight.reason: iOS distribution is deferred for the first internal beta (Android + desktop only), tracked in #769

desktop-updater.reason: the desktop auto-update channel (RustFS + llamenos-releases, #714/#715) is out of beta scope; testers install from the GitHub Release, verified by the desktop-installer surface. Re-require this once #714/#715 land

macos.reason: no Apple Developer account yet (#741): tauri-release.yml deliberately withholds the macOS bundle because Gatekeeper would refuse to open an unsigned/un-notarized .dmg. Re-require once #741 lands
